reviewed_by: Codex review of malformed provider tool-argument diagnostics
reason: The OpenAI-compatible adapter previously reduced malformed native tool-call JSON to a generic error, and its detailed JSONDecodeError catch was a warning hidden by the production error-level diagnostic threshold. The selected cases prove that the real durable provider log now records an error with exact decoder coordinates, provider response identity, model, tool, byte count and a one-way fingerprint without retaining argument values; that existing malformed and unidentified calls remain unexecuted; and that valid streamed tool-call assembly still completes.
exclusions: No frontend, Playwright, native, production-build, LAN, or physical-device gates apply because the API response, chat failure text, UI, persistence, origin behavior, and executable packaging are unchanged. No live provider call is selected because malformed output is nondeterministic and the diagnostic boundary is fully exercised with the same OpenAI-compatible response shape. Full suites and unrelated provider adapters are excluded.
